name: ampex-atr-drum-glue
description: Tape glue + color on a drum bus via the UADx Ampex ATR-102 — REPRO, 15 IPS, Ampex 456, Cal +6, 1/2" tape, NAB, transformer ON, wow&flutter/crosstalk OFF (tight). Driven harder than the 2-bus presets for audible tape compression (the glue) + 3rd-harmonic body, slightly narrowed. The ATR (smooth 2-track mastering deck) counterpart to the punchier Studer A800 drum-bus presets (tight-70s-*).
intended_for: a stereo DRUM bus / drum mix wanting tape glue + warmth (smoother/glossier than the A800).
plugin_build: uaudio_*.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless; the UAD *.component twin passes audio through unprocessed offline, do NOT use it)

target_signature.comment: measured dry -> processed on projects/drums-kit/mix/bus_70s_balanced.wav (peak-normed), +12 dB drive. centroid in [L] measure-spectrum units (dry == 4266, crest 25.0). Tape glue: ~3.3 dB of compression (crest 25.0 -> 21.7) + gentle warm darkening.

notes: +12 dB drive pushes ~3-5 dB of tape compression (the glue) and adds 3rd-harmonic body. Driving harder stacks odd harmonics (3rd -> 5th -> 7th) = harshness; stop the moment the top spits and trim back.
Smoother/glossier than the Studer A800 drum-bus presets (tight-70s-*); for punchier/drier American-console drums use [[api-vision-channel-strip]] / [[kit-bb-a5]] instead.
For more aggression: tape 250 (earliest saturation) or 1/4" (leaner/brighter). For cleaner: 30 IPS / GP9 / 1".
